jobs.description:
As a production worker, you're the driving force behind the production process. You ensure the production line always runs smoothly by replenishing and trimming meat as needed. Don't worry if you don't have experience with knives – you'll learn! You'll also help load and unload trucks and work in various departments, such as production, packaging, and shipping. No two days are the same for a production worker, and that's what makes it so rewarding.
We're looking for a production worker who's a hands-on person.

You're physically fit, speak fluent Dutch or English, and enjoy working independently and as part of a team. As a production worker, you take responsibility, remain calm under pressure, and prioritize effectively.

Flexibility is key: you'll start between 3:30 and 6:30 a.m. and work until everything is finished, OR you'll work in two shifts: from 3:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. and the other week from 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.

Working in a refrigerated environment? No problem for you!

 

Eager to get stuck in? Then you're the production worker we want on our team!

We're on the lookout for a 
Mid-Level AI Systems Engineer who bridges AI engineering and MLOps. Someone who loves getting hands-on with LLMs, agents, and RAG pipelines, and who cares just as much about what happens once a model reaches production as about building it in the first place. In this role, you'll design, build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI systems, with a strong focus on generative AI, LLM-based applications, and reliable machine learning operations. In practice your time is split roughly between 60-70% AI Engineering and 30-40% MLOps.
 

In this role you sit at the intersection of engineering and operations, working across teams and disciplines. You'll report to the Head of ML at Sagacify and collaborate with the wider Sagacify and Craftzing delivery organisation. A role that can naturally grow towards a Team Lead position over time.
 

What you'll do :
 

AI Engineering (60-70%)
 
 

• Orchestrate AI system components: LLMs, vector databases, APIs, orchestration layers, and user interfaces 

• Develop autonomous agents and conversational systems that can plan actions and interact with external tools or APIs 

• Build and optimise RAG pipelines connecting enterprise data sources to LLMs for grounded, contextualised, reliable answers 

• Evaluate system quality through generative AI metrics, coherence tests, and production monitoring (latency, API costs, bias) 

• Deploy and scale solutions with strong attention to latency, security, reliability and cost efficiency 

• Keep an eye on the ecosystem for new models, frameworks and techniques, including open-source tools such as LangChain, LangGraph, Langfuse, etc. 

• Perform prompt and context engineering to improve output quality, reduce hallucinations, and manage conversational state effectively  

MLOps (30-40%)
 
 

• Build and maintain automation for model deployment, including CI/CD pipelines and automated testing 

• Continuously monitor model performance in production, including drift detection and quality metric tracking 

• Manage updates of libraries, models, and related dependencies in production environments 

• Ensure versioning, reproducibility and safe rollout of models and AI services 

• Collaborate closely with ML engineers, developers, DevOps and infrastructure teams for smooth delivery 

• Stay current with the latest MLOps practices, tools and platform components  

You stay in the code, you stay curious about what happens after deployment, and you keep learning as you go.

 

• You have 3 to 5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or related fields 

• You have a solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: Transformers, attention mechanisms, generation parameters and fine-tuning approaches 

• You have strong problem-solving ability and algorithmic creativity 

• You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

• You have a team spirit and enjoy collaborating across multiple roles 

• You bring rigour, responsiveness and a good incident-handling mindset 

• You're autonomous, curious, and quick to learn new tools 

• You can communicate fluently in Dutch, English and French, or at least the first two languages  

Don’t worry if you don’t tick every single box, what matters most is the right mindset and a drive to learn. If you think we’re a match, we’d love to hear from you.

Are you passionate about healthcare, science and building meaningful relationships? Do you enjoy combining scientific discussions with commercial impact? Then this could be the opportunity you've been looking for. We're looking for a Pharmacy Advisor to strengthen our team in Wallonia. In this field-based role, you'll partner with pharmacists and pharmacy teams to promote our portfolio of trusted consumer healthcare brands through scientific education, product expertise and best-in-class in-store execution. 

As a Pharmacy Advisor, you are the scientific and educational partner for pharmacies within your territory. Through peer-to-peer conversations, you help pharmacists and their teams understand the benefits of our products, enabling them to confidently recommend the right solutions to consumers. Working closely with the Selling In Representative, you focus on scientific detailing, pharmacy staff training and retail excellence, while your colleague manages the commercial relationship and ordering activities.

What you'll be doing : 

 
• Build strong, long-term relationships with pharmacists, pharmacy owners and pharmacy assistants. 
Deliver engaging scientific product presentations and educational discussions. 

 
•  
Organise learning sessions and product training for pharmacy teams. 

 
•  
Drive product recommendation by highlighting product features, benefits and points of differentiation. 

 
•  
Ensure excellent in-store execution, including product availability, shelf visibility, merchandising and promotional implementation. 

 
• Analyse territory performance and identify opportunities to grow categories and brands. 
 
•  
Accurately document customer interactions and activities using CRM tools. 

 
•  
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing and Commercial Excellence. 

 
• Maintain full compliance with company policies and local healthcare regulations. 

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Medicine or another life sciences discipline. 
 
• A degree in Business, Marketing or Economics is also considered. 
 
•  
Experience in pharmaceutical sales or promoting products to healthcare professionals is an advantage, but motivated graduates are also encouraged to apply. Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence through scientific knowledge. 

 
• Customer-focused, relationship-oriented and commercially driven. 
Self-motivated, organised and comfortable working independently in a field-based role. 

 
• Analytical mindset with strong planning and prioritisation skills. 
 

 
• Comfortable using digital tools and CRM systems. 
 
•  
Intermediate English is considered a plus.

For our client, an international organization active in Aftermarket services for advanced mobility systems, we are looking for a Technical Customer Trainer who can step in and make an impact. Language Skills
 

 
• Fluent in Dutch, French, and English, both spoken and written.

Personal Competencies
 

 
• Excellent presentation and communication skills.
 
• Passion for teaching and developing others.
 
• Customer-oriented and solution-focused mindset.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

jobs.description:
Present in more than 190 countries, with 12,000 employees and €5.8 billion in business activity, Redion is the world leader in employee benefits and the second-largest provider of assistance and travel insurance services.

We support millions of people worldwide through simple, seamless and accessible solutions across protection, health, mobility and assistance.

Technology and Artificial Intelligence are at the core of our development, enhancing customer experience while valuing human expertise.

Our values: Care, Collaboration, Agility, Reliability and Expertise guide our actions every day.

Joining Redion means contributing to a fast-growing global platform within an agile and international environment, while making a tangible impact.

Our ambition: to become the world's leading Care partner.
Always ready. Always on.

Jobomschrijving

As a Regional Head of Travel, Health, IT & Cyber, you will directly contribute to ensuring the performance, governance, and continuous improvement of operations across Northern Europe.

Within the Operations department, you will work in a multi-country, transformational and operational environment, driving excellence in service delivery while shaping the future of our Travel, Health, IT & Cyber activities.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Define and execute the regional operational strategy aligned with business objectives
• Drive operational performance by managing KPIs, optimizing processes, and controlling costs
• Ensure high-quality service delivery and customer satisfaction across all operations
• Lead and develop multi-country teams, fostering collaboration and accountability
• Manage key stakeholders and governance across Operations, IT, HR, Finance, and Business Lines
• Drive transformation initiatives, including digitalization, automation, and continuous improvement
• Build capabilities and develop talent across the region

• Education: Master’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field
• Experience: You have 5  years of experience in operations, including senior leadership roles, ideally within medical assistance, healthcare, or service environments
• Skills: Operational management, process optimization, performance management, transformation and digitalization expertise
• Languages: Fluent in English (C1); additional NE Unit languages are an asset (Dutch, French, German, Italian,)
• Soft skills: Strong leadership, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, stakeholder management, analytical mindset, adaptability and resilience

Founded in 1963, Europ Assistance—the inventor of assistance—has been supporting customers for over sixty years. Today, Generali Employee Benefits is part of that story.

Together, we are Redion: one global care partner supporting people and organizations in more than 190 countries through a trusted network of providers and assistance centres.

Our mission is simple: one name, one purpose, one team.

Redion Northern Europe is a Business Unit covering Austria, Belgium, Germany, Luxembourg, the Netherlands and Switzerland.

Working at Redion means being part of a dynamic, international environment where innovation, operational excellence and people development are key drivers of our success.

Jobomschrijving

• Establishing and continuously improving Workforce Management frameworks, standards and governance
• Optimizing staffing levels, scheduling and workforce allocation to meet service and productivity targets
• Monitoring workforce performance and driving continuous improvement initiatives
• Developing reporting, dashboards and workforce analytics to support decision-making

• Excellent forecasting and capacity planning capabilities
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to anticipate risks and translate data into insights
• Strategic thinker with strong operational execution skills
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
• Proactive, solution-oriented and data-driven mindset
• Strong ownership, accountability and decision-making skills
• Proven leadership and coaching capabilities
• Ability to manage complexity in a multi-country environment
Languages

• English (C1)
• French and/or Dutch required
• German is a plusTraining and experience
• Minimum 5 years of experience in Workforce Management
• Proven experience in forecasting, workforce planning, scheduling and capacity management
• Experience in a call center, assistance or customer operations environment is strongly preferred
• Experience in leading and developing teams
• Strong knowledge of Workforce Management methodologies and tools
• Knowledge of Verint is an asset
• Experience in a multi-site and/or international environment is an advantage

• Administrative experience or strong administrative skills.

Proactive and able to work independently. 
 

Good computer skills and ability to quickly learn new systems.

Personal Qualities
